setup: Headless ot_emu; MKII panel; stopped transport; 128×64 LCD at integer scale 6.

image.what: Native octabam image of Sidechain Compressor alone with the stock FX2 effects kept, built by the SDK Modwerk ships; SPRING REV gives up its code space.
image.build: python3 scripts/export-composition-proofs.py PRIVATE_SDK DEST --app . --vendored-sdk --static-stock --modules POOL --menus MENUS --select sidechain-compressor:true --image-dir IMAGES

composedImage.what: The complete image the site composes for the same selection, with its appended runtime and the core logger. The same plan drew the same three frames.

emulatorBuild.source: ot_emu from a local sambanks/octabam checkout (HEAD 4781ca40, 21 October 2026); not rebuilt from this repository's sdk/octabam copy.

projectSetup.recipe: No project and no private template: the capture script writes an empty scratch card and the firmware starts a new project. The first-run date dialog is accepted with YES, track T1 is selected, FUNC + FX1 opens FX1 SETUP and encoder LEVEL is turned eight rows to COMPRESSOR, the module's row, before YES assigns it.

review.selectionConfirmed: YES assigns COMPRESSOR before the SETUP page is captured: its right-hand side shows RMS, MON (OFF), KEY, KGN, KBAS and KWID, KWID with its link clip to KBAS.
review.observedKey: T2 after encoder C delta 8, drawn on the KEY rotary switch; not evidence of T1-to-T5 tutorial audio.
review.pixelEdits: None; actual LCD framebuffer at integer scale 6, only the two display colours are mapped.
review.comparedWith0.1.2: The selection and KEY captures show 0.2.0's page 2; the main page is stock COMPRESSOR's, as before.

limitations: UI-only MKII session: stopped transport, no loaded audio or hardware qualification.
FX1 selection, main page and SETUP with the KEY switch observed. FX2 and MKI remain source-described, not captured.
No MON audio, ducking, project reload or timing qualification claimed.
The emulator was built from upstream octabam, not this repository's sdk/octabam copy; its sub-revisions were not recorded.
